nodes.description: State variable holding the ChainLink ETH/USD aggregator interface (0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419) used by Resolver.
Internal pure helper converting raw bytes to uint256 via inline assembly.
Inline assembly 'value := mload(add(_bytes,0x20))' that blindly reads the first 32 bytes of an arbitrary length bytes buffer.
Public view function that loops over caller-supplied price feed addresses, performs low-level staticcalls to them and to ethUsdPriceFeed, and returns PriceData structs.
Array of externally supplied price-feed contract addresses (unvalidated, attacker-controlled from calldata).
Low-level staticcall with abi.encodeWithSignature('latestAnswer()'/'decimals()') to an arbitrary, unvalidated price feed address supplied by the caller.
Dynamically allocated PriceData[] array populated per feed inside the loop.
uint loop counter used to index priceFeeds and tokensPriceInETH.
Raw bytes returned by the staticcall to latestAnswer() on priceFeeds[i].
Raw bytes returned by the staticcall to decimals() on priceFeeds[i].
Raw bytes returned by the staticcall to latestAnswer() on ethUsdPriceFeed.
Raw bytes returned by the staticcall to decimals() on ethUsdPriceFeed.
Low-level staticcall with abi.encodeWithSignature('latestAnswer()'/'decimals()') to the hard-coded state-variable price feed address.

edges.reason: getPrices reads the ethUsdPriceFeed state variable to compare against each supplied feed and to build ethPriceInUsd.
address(ethUsdPriceFeed) is used as the target of the low-level staticcall in getPrices.
getPrices takes the caller-supplied priceFeeds array as input.
The staticcalls to each priceFeeds[i] execute inside the getPrices loop body.
The staticcalls to ethUsdPriceFeed are executed at the end of getPrices.
getPrices allocates and writes the tokensPriceInETH array.
getPrices declares and increments the loop counter i.
The unvalidated address priceFeeds[i] flows directly into the low-level staticcall target.
The loop index i selects which priceFeeds[i] address is called by the staticcall.
The loop index i is used to write tokensPriceInETH[i].
priceData bytes are the return value of the staticcall to latestAnswer() on priceFeeds[i].
decimalsData bytes are the return value of the staticcall to decimals() on priceFeeds[i].
ethPriceData bytes are the return value of the staticcall to latestAnswer() on ethUsdPriceFeed.
ethDecimalsData bytes are the return value of the staticcall to decimals() on ethUsdPriceFeed.
priceData is passed to toUint256 when building each PriceData entry.
decimalsData is passed to toUint256 for the decimals field.
ethPriceData is passed to toUint256 for ethPriceInUsd.price.
ethDecimalsData is passed to toUint256 for ethPriceInUsd.decimals.
toUint256 executes the inline assembly mload to decode the raw bytes into a uint256.
The decoded priceData value is stored into tokensPriceInETH[i].price.
The decoded decimalsData value is stored into tokensPriceInETH[i].decimals.
